text:
Talia CSM: FYI prepping QBR for ORBIT (renewal in 21 days). We just got an alert: embed token burn jumped ~2.6x after they enabled a new tooling flow that does function calls + embeddings together. Need a clear slide: root cause, 3-scenario spend forecast, recommended temporary mitigations (soft throttle/credits escrow), and a short customer feedback ask. Can the triage team pull numbers + recs by EOD?

Hector (FinOps): On it. Quick ask: send me last 90d + current commit and whether they have committed overage clauses. I'll produce baseline / trend / surge and a suggested cushion. Also will quantify savings if batching + caching applied.

Mina (Enablement): I'll draft a one-pager for their engineering lead covering batching, prefix/KV caching, and a short how-to for function+embed orchestration. Will include code snippets and a 3-min screencast link.

Luis Eng: infra traces show the spike from route `/v1/chat/with-embeds` where each message triggers an immediate embed call (no dedupe) plus function result embeddings. Adding a short-term concurrent call cap of 6 for that route and tagging function-mediated embed calls for telemetry. ETA 15m.

alerts-bot: Billing alert: ORBIT crossed 76% of monthly token allocation. AlertID: a-ORBIT-7731

Talia CSM: Action items: 1) Hector  scenarios + recommended cushion + savings table by 16:00. 2) Luis  cap + telemetry + brief RCA note. 3) Mina  enablement one-pager + screencast link. I will draft a customer-facing note proposing a 30-min mitigation call and offer a temporary credits-escrow while we implement fixes.

Hector (FinOps): quick baseline numbers (pulled):
```
90d_total_tokens: 2,400,000
30d_tokens: 980,000
7d_tokens: 360,000
monthly_commit: 1,200,000
```
Projected month-end if current rate holds: ~1.9M (58% over commit). With batching + dedupe on top routes (assume 2.5x reduction), projected drops to ~840k (under commit). Recommend proposing a 15% renewal cushion + one-off escrow credits to cover current cycle while remediation completes.

Luis Eng: cap deployed. Telemetry tag `fn_embed=true` added to requests where function outputs are embedded. Will push a small server-side dedupe that collapses identical vectors pre-ingest. ETA 2hrs for that dedupe rollout.

Mina (Enablement): one-pager draft ready, includes Node & Python snippets and a tiny example for function chaining to avoid double-embedding. Also recording short screencast: https://redwood.app/screencasts/embed-best-practices (will attach final).

credits-bot: Note: We can provision a one-time credit escrow for ORBIT up to 20% of monthly commit pending remediation. Request needs approval from SalesOps.

Talia CSM: I'll coordinate with SalesOps for escrow approval and add the escrow ask to the renewal packet. Hector  can you include an explicit before/after chart and a sensitivity table (10/25/50% uplifts) in the slide? Mina  add the how-to bullet as an appendix.

Hector (FinOps): adding before/after chart + sensitivity. For the QBR speak: recommended mitigation path = immediate concurrency cap + one-off credits escrow + 2-week remediation plan (deploy dedupe + client-side batching + KV cache). That should protect renewal conversation.

Luis Eng: rolled out server-side dedupe to canary (10% traffic) and it's collapsing ~42% of duplicate vectors so far. If trend holds, dedupe alone will reduce token burn significantly. Will escalate to full rollout after canary metrics stable.

Talia CSM: Perfect. I'll draft the customer note: explain root cause, timeline, offer credits escrow and remediation call, and capture feedback on the new function+embed pattern (ask them whether this flow is intentional). Posting draft in #customer-comm for review in 30m.

alerts-bot: Billing alert acknowledged: monitoring after cap and canary dedupe.

Mina (Enablement): uploaded one-pager and sample snippets to the QBR appendix. Screencast link final: https://redwood.app/screencasts/embed-workflows-3min

Hector (FinOps): slide deck updated; added an "ask" for a 15% cushion at renewal + recommended escrow language for SalesOps.

Talia CSM: Thanks team  great triage. I'll run the customer call tomorrow and include the QBR slide. If the alerts fire again I will escalate to CTO.
